about_the_game:
Play a simple roguelite dungeon-crawling RPG!

How It Works:

  • Choose from a set of characters, customize their name and class, then go to The Tower's Guild. (You may edit your character mid-game).

  • Enter into a set of dungeons that are randomly selected, ensuring no two runs are the same.

  • On-map enemy encounters, loot treasure chests, and find the warp to the next floor.

  • Every 10th floor, you'll be facing a boss that will be randomly selected as well. Every time you beat this specific boss, their level will increase by 1.

  • Talk to The Tower's Guild Representative to buy better equipment and prepare for another run.

  • This demo version can let you play up to Floor: 10.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Microsoft® Windows® XP / Vista / 7 (32-bit/64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel® Pentium® 4 2.0 GHz equivalent or faster processor
  • Memory: 512 MB RAM
  • Graphics: 1024 x 768 pixels or higher desktop resolution
  • Storage: 400 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: These minimum system requirements are the same of "RPG Maker VX Ace" software.
